title: Strict tensor descent in the fixed tower presentation
statement: Fix ell,E,T and D as in [def-sp-reduction-tower-data]. For every isomorphism e from the section ring of the pulled-back integral coefficients to the completed ring, there is an additive ordinary reduction functor to the given strict coefficient-tower category, with level isomorphisms to D.scalar(e followed by the n-th ell-power projection). On every local pure tensor its strict transition is the quotient-induced map. There is a functor red between the ordinary unbounded derived categories and a universal left-derived comparison to this ordinary functor, invertible on every K-flat complex; every evaluation of red is naturally isomorphic to the corresponding D.scalar derived extension. No normalization of derived reduction maps, constructibility, Tor bound, or qcqs assumption is asserted.

proof.text: Compose e with the limit projections. Limit-cone naturality gives compatible scalar maps; apply strictCoefficientTensorDescent to the actual quotient sequence.

proof.text: Uncurry the ringed sequence-site systems into StrictRingSystem and apply D.equivalence.inverse. Its section and transition normalizations and uniqueness of the sheafified scalar-extension adjoint transport the ordinary level isomorphisms and pure-tensor equations to D.scalar.

Exact jointly conservative evaluations detect the resulting derived isomorphisms. The localized evaluations are the specified scalar extensions.

lean.statement:
theorem sp_reduction_tower_presentation_descent (D : SpCoefficientTowersAbelian l E T)
    (coefficient : spIntegralSectionRing l E T ≅
      WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T) :
    ∃ (ordinary : spIntegralSectionModules l E T ⥤ spCoefficientTowers l E T)
        (_additive : ordinary.Additive)
        (level : spReductionOrdinaryLevels l E T D coefficient ordinary),
        IsSpReductionTransition l E T D coefficient ordinary level ∧
        ∃ (red : DerivedCategory (spIntegralSectionModules l E T) ⥤
            spDerivedCoefficientTowers l E T D)
          (counit : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ red ⟶
            ordinary.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ spTowerLocalization l E T D),
          red.IsLeftDerivedFunctor counit
            (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (spIntegralSectionModules l E T) (.up ℤ)) ∧
          (∀ P : CochainComplex (spIntegralSectionModules l E T) ℤ,
            CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := spIntegralSectionRing l E T)
              P → IsIso (counit.app P)) ∧
          Nonempty (spReductionDerivedEvaluations l E T D coefficient red)
